corridor_responsibilities.duty: Steward owns artillery death before retreat and before the western civilian becomes an artillery candidate. Ground blocking provides no artillery containment.
Midnight clears eastern roadblock #3, intercepts following officers, then clears western #1. Track confinement and actual arrival separately.
Melantha clears eastern roadblock #4 before the second civilian arrives, intercepts following officers, then clears western #2.
Fang hands upper-inner containment to Spot. Spot and medicine retain the queue until central Steward kills it.
Friston retains three enemies; downstream Fang supplies two additional real blocking slots. #34 must block on Friston or Fang and remain in returning Steward's range.
Midnight remains the upper-outer blocker. Fang temporarily adds damage, then leaves for lower interception; no unsupported replacement or healing is credited.
Melantha retains lower-outer interception, supported by Ansel's extended healing before his rotation and her two attack skills.

Early crossfire, eastern upper roadblock clearance and upper-outer interception.
Lower-outer interception and eastern lower roadblock destruction.
Initial reciprocal medicine; extended range reaches Melantha.
Heal Ansel, both inner holders and eastern Steward.
Kill artillery during its eastern vertical traversals.
Replace Fang; healing mode supports Ansel and Friston.
Assist Midnight against the first upper officer pair.
Downstream lower interception, including overflow armor #34.
Finish armor held by Spot, Friston and downstream Fang.
Returning medicine covers Fang [4,4], Friston [4,5], Steward [5,5] and Melantha [6,5].
Destroy the western upper roadblock after hostile clearance.
Destroy the western lower roadblock after hostile clearance.

formation_structure.artillery_damage_budget: With the supported 6% Steward ATK talent, 36 ordinary hits at 249.1 plus nine enhanced hits at 473.29 total 13227.21. Require 45 actual artillery hits; device attacks and shooter interruptions do not count. First contact around frame 2280 predicts the 45th hit around 4392, conditional on uninterrupted cadence.
formation_structure.configuration: Use supplied normal-mode debug configurations; credit no unsupported dodge, probabilistic extra healing or robot talent.
critical_predictions: Earlier Midnight skill and earlier Fang assistance must preserve at least 433 Midnight HP before final upper-outer officer exposure; this is a planning threshold, not verified evidence.
Hibiscus and Spot must retain both inner holders during Ansel's 159–229 second medical rotation.
Fang's downstream block must occur before #34 escapes; returning Ansel must heal Fang before a lethal fourth 340-arts packet.
formation_structure.medical_geometry: Initially both physicians cover each other, both inner holders and Steward. Steward and Ansel are adjacent: their shared artillery splash is explicitly retained and assigned Spot support. Spot's active nine-cell range covers Ansel [2,6], Friston [4,5] and later Fang [4,4]. Returning Ansel [5,3] RIGHT covers the downstream lower interception.

redeployment_accounting.client_cost_escalation: UNKNOWN; unchanged costs are current-executor rules.

Fang leaves only after that pair is dead; this starts his downstream-interception cooldown.
Steward withdraws after artillery death. Born shells still settle at their locked points.
Ansel withdraws after artillery settlement and lower-outer recovery; his remaining active skill duration is intentionally forfeited.
Fang returns at [4,4] before late lower runners and armor can pass Friston.
Midnight withdraws after the last upper-outer officer dies.
Steward returns centrally after 2101 frames of cooldown.
Melantha withdraws after the final lower-outer officer dies.
Ansel returns at [5,3] RIGHT before downstream Fang's predicted lethal armor packet.
Midnight returns to the western upper roadblock.
Melantha returns to the western lower roadblock.

mandatory_tactical_invariants.requirement: Exactly eight distinct catalog IDs; every operator has rarity 1–3 and normal_mode=true. Every deployment uses the supplied legal configuration, integer [row,col] and a cardinal direction.
Never deploy on [[1,2],[6,2],[1,6],[6,6]], including after roadblock destruction.
Frames are fixed predictions. Gates do not authorize automatic retiming, substitutions or actions on dead operators.
Fang survives both credited grants and his living retreat. His opening officer must be dead before 1470; Spot must block the next upper-inner approach after deployment at 2581.
Verify HP and heal recipients before each artillery or armor packet. Historical healing totals and average HPS do not certify this formation.
Fang's first return must settle the pair before 4080 and leave Midnight with at least 433 HP before final outer attacks. Failure refutes permanent Midnight containment.
Require actual artillery death before 4440, positive surviving patient HP and settlement of born shells. A surviving artillery invalidates the scheduled caster and medical rotations.
Ansel's absence must not kill Spot, Friston or Hibiscus. Ansel returns at 6871 with fresh initial SP, without carrying his former active skill.
#34 must produce a real BLOCK on Friston [4,5] or Fang [4,4], then DAMAGE from central Steward and eventual ENEMY_DEATH. Fang [4,4] and both inner holders are within Steward [5,5] DOWN coverage.
Blocked armor uses its actual damage type. Budget 340 arts per attack against Fang with zero RES, not 80 physical damage. Returning Ansel must heal before Fang's lethal packet.

Ordinary operators neither attack nor block civilians. Track both eastern restraints, both western restraints, officer proximity, artillery acquisition, residual impacts and actual protected arrivals.
No death is required. Record any death's damage, blocking and cooldown contribution; death refunds zero. Unexpected deaths invalidate affected later actions rather than creating free replacements.

Require remaining_life>0, zero leaks, exhausted spawns, no active enemies, zero protected-target deaths and exactly two expected protected targets safely arrived. Operator deaths are recorded separately.

Fang catches overflow and #34; central Steward supplies real arts damage; returning Ansel prevents Fang's lethal repeated arts sequence.
Destroy both western restraints and continue until both civilian arrivals and complete hostile exhaustion are observed.

skill_intents.intent: Automatic DP; only opening grants 570 and 1320 fund the initial formation. No grant is credited during either retreat interval.

Supported ATK increase and arts conversion. First window accelerates eastern clearance and reduces early officer damage; second handles final outer officers. Self-blocked enemies interrupt inner crossfire.

Single-recipient healing only. Initial extended windows recover Melantha and support eastern mixed damage. The 4383 activation is interrupted by retreat at 4770. Returning skill readiness is recomputed from initial SP10.
Twenty-second healing boosts with thirty inactive seconds between activations; actual recipient selection remains decisive.
Twenty-five-second adjacent healing with forty inactive seconds between windows. Blocking continues; ordinary attacks stop.
Shorten paired and late lower-outer officer exposure.
Automatic enhanced arts hits and supported highest-defense priority. No manual activation.

revised_operational_plans.tactical_thesis: Advance Midnight before Friston, restore Spot, and fund eastern Steward with two Fang grants and a living retreat. Fang first assists the upper officer pair, then redeploys downstream of Friston to intercept lower overflow and final armor #34. After artillery settlement, Ansel rotates to heal that downstream position. This is a complete, unsimulated current-model hypothesis with narrow upper-outer survival and medical-handoff predictions, not a demonstrated win.

revised_stage_understanding.evidence_status: Read-only static inspection only; no stage simulation was run.

fact_separation.GameData: Operator configurations, roadblock HP8000/DEF200/RES20, ranges, enemy panels and source routes.
fact_separation.UNKNOWN: Exact client timing, build equivalence, ordinary roadblock navigation and client target-order deviations.
fact_separation.USER_CONFIRMED_TACTICAL_PREMISE: Completed attacks may buy time through their intervals. No universal pre-swing target lock, cancellation or retreat immunity is assumed.
fact_separation.current_model: Neutral civilians cannot be ordinarily attacked or blocked; officers can attack them; artillery locks at projectile birth; ordinary attacks choose at strike; deployed-only actions, refunds and cooldowns apply.

bait_retreat_or_sacrifice.beneficiaries: Earlier crossfire preserves Midnight; settled artillery permits caster and physician rotation.
bait_retreat_or_sacrifice.cooldown: Completed ordinary strikes consume their normal interval. Artillery cooldown begins at cast; born shells persist.
bait_retreat_or_sacrifice.decoy_survival: Fang and Midnight must survive their assigned actual strikes; neither retreats during an assumed pre-swing lock.
bait_retreat_or_sacrifice.enemy_and_attack: Upper officers' completed ordinary strikes and artillery's born fixed-point shells.
bait_retreat_or_sacrifice.residual_risk: Released enemies are never discarded. Born shells and civilians retain their actual positions and risks.
bait_retreat_or_sacrifice.successors: Spot replaces opening Fang; downstream Fang later catches Friston overflow.

candidates.cost: Narrow HP margins, three Fang deployments, two long medical/output cooldowns and a 199-DP gross full-stage schedule.
candidates.most_dangerous_window: Midnight's final unhealed officers, followed by the 159–229 second medical rotation and Fang's first armor packets.
candidates.same_phase_responsibilities: Four corridor interceptions, reciprocal physicians, eastern artillery output and Spot's blocking/healing fusion.
candidates.selection_reason: Selected because it retains demonstrated Spot support while advancing first damage, artillery coverage and a real downstream #34 interception. Its decisive actions are expressible. Survival remains conditional and explicitly falsifiable.
candidates.slot_reduction: Remove Beagle and Lancet-2; add Spot, reducing nine IDs to eight.
candidates.staged_responsibilities: Fang moves from opening economy to upper-pair damage and then downstream lower interception. Steward returns centrally. Ansel returns with a different healing geometry. Outer fighters finish western roadblocks.

candidates.bait_retreat_or_sacrifice: No required bait or death. A caster death provides no refund and removes permanent lower output.
candidates.cost: Durin costs 12 DP and has only 952 HP; a 938-damage shell leaves 14 HP. Her adjacent placement creates an additional nearly lethal patient every cycle.
candidates.most_dangerous_window: Durin's entry during repeated Hibiscus-targeted artillery splash, followed by shared eastern physician/caster damage.

opening_cost_and_pressure.dependency: Each credited Vanilla grant requires its own manual activation and survival; active ten-second periods pause recharge.

candidates.raw_positions: Vanilla [3,5] UP; Friston [4,5] RIGHT; Midnight [1,5] UP; Melantha [6,5] RIGHT; physicians [2,6] UP and [5,6] DOWN; Steward [2,7] UP; Durin [5,5] RIGHT.
candidates.same_phase_responsibilities: Vanilla owns upper-inner blocking and manual economy; Durin supplies permanent lower-inner arts while Steward attacks artillery.
candidates.selection_reason: Not selected. Its independent opening is affordable, but permanent arts is not permanent survival: the declared medical geometry repeats the failed fragile-caster dependency and increases simultaneous packet demand.
candidates.slot_reduction: Remove Fang, Beagle and Lancet-2; add Vanilla and Durin, giving eight IDs.
candidates.staged_responsibilities: Steward later returns centrally; outer fighters rotate west. Vanilla retains her lane rather than reproducing Fang's opening.

candidates.cost: Cardigan's self-heal improves survival but does not accelerate clearance. Against DEF200 she deals only 105 ordinary damage to an 8000-HP roadblock, needing 77 uninterrupted attacks, plus hostile interruptions.
candidates.exact_action_enemy_phase_gap: The decisive proposed Yato retreat during an officer's pre-swing cannot preserve that target selection: this executor chooses the ordinary target at ATTACK_STRIKE.
candidates.most_dangerous_window: Second civilian confinement at the eastern lower roadblock while artillery revisits the lower eastern sector.

raw_bait_plan.beneficiary: Cardigan gains interception and damage time.
raw_bait_plan.cooldown: A completed strike consumes the two-second interval; a pre-strike retreat does not establish target locking.
raw_bait_plan.decoy_survival: Yato must remain through ATTACK_STRIKE if cooldown consumption is claimed.
raw_bait_plan.refund_and_redeploy: Living Yato retreat refunds 3 DP; death refunds zero. Same-ID return requires 40 seconds and the actual deployment cost.
raw_bait_plan.residual_risk: Officers may still attack nearby civilians; artillery shells persist independently.
raw_bait_plan.successor: Cardigan must already cover the released officer's remaining route.

candidates.same_phase_responsibilities: Cardigan fuses lower-outer blocking and self-healing; Yato supplies attack absorption while both physicians support the eastern formation.
candidates.selection_reason: Not selected. Completed-hit absorption is checkable, but the claimed pre-swing handoff is not expressible, and slow eastern clearance leaves the second civilian exposed to repeated artillery acquisition. The raw proposal is retained without inventing a favorable lock or navigation rule.
candidates.slot_reduction: Remove Melantha, Beagle and Lancet-2; add Cardigan and Yato, giving eight IDs.
candidates.staged_responsibilities: Yato withdraws after an officer strike, uses his supported 40-second redeploy cooldown and returns as a temporary interceptor. Cardigan remains the successor.

m58_open_roster_comparison.comparison_scope: Three structures compared together in one model-authored selection pass. Raw reasons are retained; Python did not choose tactics.

Returning Ansel heals Fang before a lethal packet.

revised_strategic_hypotheses.status: UNSIMULATED; narrow HP and medical-handoff predictions remain unverified.

revised_tactical_requirements.artillery: Require 45 actual hits, artillery death before retreat, mixed-damage survival and residual-shell settlement.
revised_tactical_requirements.failure_handling: Any failed invariant rejects this fixed candidate; no silent retiming, invented successor or action on an absent unit is permitted.
revised_tactical_requirements.late_rotation: Recompute readiness after each real retreat. Ansel's new position must deliver an actual heal before Fang dies.
revised_tactical_requirements.opening: Verify earlier Midnight output, both Fang grants, a living refund and all first contacts; failed economic dependencies remain survival failures.
revised_tactical_requirements.protection: Track every roadblock confinement segment and both actual arrivals; ordinary operators cannot heal or block civilians.
revised_tactical_requirements.verification_limit: Static checks confirmed opening DP balances and declared key healing/range coverage. They did not certify combat survival, target sequencing or full-stage success.

revision_hypothesis.if_expected_event_absent: Reject the predicted 45-hit artillery timetable and dependent retreats. Inspect actual visibility, range, target selection and attack cadence; do not substitute device damage, assume a kill or automatically retime the plan.
revision_hypothesis.tactical_hypothesis: Replace the failed permanent fragile-caster assumption with earlier supported crossfire, Spot's adjacent healing, a downstream Fang interception and a physician return that actually covers that interception. Earlier eastern Steward coverage must remove artillery before civilian acquisition and enable the later rotations.
